source_identity_note: The input is the tracked tree from git archive of source_commit, not the later documentation commit containing this receipt. Source files bound below also matched the corresponding wheel members byte for byte.
scope: Magnetostatics chapter only. Its rectangular coil specification omits angle; it does not exercise nonzero rotations, old keywords or arbitrary geometries.
network: Not isolated or monitored; uv build and wheel installation used --offline.
plot_runtime: NOT_RUN: retained published results and three SVGs; the new full-array comparison passed at the original tolerances.
execution_environment: Native macOS-27.2.1-arm64-arm-64bit-Mach-O; fresh venv with the non-editable wheel. Python -I -B imported scirel/__init__.py from that venv’s site-packages. The run directory began with a byte-identical copy of example.py, not the source package. The host checkout remained accessible; no container or cross-platform run.
build_tools: uv 0.12.19 (Homebrew 2026-09-24 aarch64-apple-darwin); setuptools.build_meta (version pinned by source_commit's pyproject.toml); SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is the source commit timestamp.
reproduce: From the repository root, after python3 scripts/dev.py prepare (requires pre-cached wheel/build dependencies for --offline):
SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(git show -s --format=%ct "$rev") python3 scripts/dev.py run uv build --offline --wheel --out-dir "$run/wheels" "$run/source"
python3 scripts/dev.py run uv pip install --offline --python "$run/consumer/bin/python" "$run"/wheels/*.whl

cp "$run/source/tools/docs/magnetostatics/example.py" "$run/work/"; python3 scripts/dev.py run bash -ec 'cd "$1/work"; "$1/consumer/bin/python" -I -B example.py results.json >stdout.json' replay "$run"
